notes.title: We're Working on a Bestiary for Dice, Destiny and Death!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!

We are working on a new feature for our game, Dice, Destiny and Death – a Bestiary! In this Bestiary, you will be able to read about all the monsters you encounter during your adventures.

This new feature will help you find the best strategies to defeat different monsters by providing detailed information about each one.
